scope.model: Goodfire four-layer t-9d2b8f02, native MLP layers 0 and 1
scope.family: Supplied GELU architecture with shared overcomplete reader; numerical reuse diagnostic, not algorithm discovery
scope.fitting: 4096 positions in eight 512-token passages, 256 Adam updates, same declared hyperparameters; proposal products float32; saved replay float64
scope.heldout: 1024 positions, project-seen but fit-disjoint; layerwise maximum row error divided by native layer RMS. Not the separate full-model evaluation panel.
scope.warmstart: Both start from the identical frozen-native initial-fit best program. All parameters retained, optimizer moments reset; 256 additional updates. Best training snapshot selected.
scope.conclusion: No learned-body advantage; learned warmstart retains step zero. These are negative fitting/faithfulness results, not a matched-compute VPD comparison.
scope.figure: Fitting and fit-disjoint replay only. The completed full-model evaluation on the declared panel is archived separately in bench/results_2951/shared_geometry_correct_panel_20261004; native won all 30 tested tolerance pairs.
scope.larger64: Same frozen-native 256-update starting parameters as the paired 8-passage continuations; 256 additional updates with identical hyperparameters, using 32,768 rather than 4,096 training positions. Evaluation arrays unchanged. More data also incurs more computation; this is not a compute-matched comparison. Snapshots selected by training error. Full-model Local/Run evaluation of these larger-data candidates was not run.
scope.research_status: Diagnostic closed: sharing a supplied GELU calculation did not demonstrate learned algorithm discovery. No matched-compute advantage over VPD is established.
